findings.title: PHI encryption boundary
findings.detail: Patient indexes and imaging metadata use customer-managed keys in Key Vault with explicit PHI classification on every blob container.

findings.title: Private data paths
findings.detail: Clinical APIs resolve storage and SQL through private endpoints; public network access remains denied on data stores.

findings.title: Audit coverage
findings.detail: Diagnostic settings stream administrative actions and data-plane queries into immutable Log Analytics workspaces.

findings.title: Regional failover documentation gap
findings.detail: Multi-region standby is described at the service level but RPO/RTO targets for clinical read paths are not attached to the manifest governance block.

findings.title: Idle analytics pool window
findings.detail: Dedicated SQL pool runs nightly ETL but remains provisioned through weekends without pause-resume automation.
